note: The classes this product has, and their stable identifiers. Canonical Sunday School class names, youngest to oldest — they carry no ages, because the age band that maps to a class is a fact about a congregation rather than about this library. Mirrors the Classes table on the sheet's Config tab and the numbered folders in the Drive library; see CONTENT_LIBRARY.md. A class id is set once and never edited: it names a Drive folder, a brief file and, one day, a content directory, and renaming it orphans all three. The tab and display names are what a teacher sees and may be changed freely.
